ignorePatterns.comment: Placeholder *.dev.me domains used in doc examples - illustrative, never real/resolvable
Root-relative Starlight routes (/foo/bar/) - validated by starlight-links-validator during npm run build, which understands the real routing table
Private loko source repo - not publicly reachable by design; internal-contributor-only build-from-source references
Same-site absolute links - validated by starlight-links-validator

TEMPORARY: loko-releases is still private as of this writing ('will be made public' has not happened yet), so unauthenticated requests 404. Remove this pattern the day loko-releases goes public - these links are otherwise correct and will resolve immediately.
